patch.value: Preserve team estimate scales and explicit effort conversions
Preserve Linear team estimate scale and declared points-to-effort mapping alongside imported estimates; identify estimates invalidated by a team scale change.
Five points never become five minutes without a declared conversion; changing one team scale affects only its items; unconvertible estimates remain usable as native points.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap checked against the installed CLI SDK public declarations, existing Linear estimate tags and round-trip features, and pm-gantt-chart duration inputs. Core estimated_minutes is numeric effort; Gantt consumes minutes and prior capacity work consumes estimates. Neither knows Linear team identity or scale settings. This feature owns provider unit provenance and an explicit scale-bound lookup conversion, preserving native points when unmapped. Existing atomic replay revision follow-up remains relevant; transactions do not exclude ordinary writers (pm-cli#1620).

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented versioned per-item unit contracts with exact discrete conversion lookups and bounded team-scoped inspection. Provenance uses lowercase hexadecimal encoding because SDK tag normalization changes letter case; the real SDK tests caught this and the producer/reader now share one codec. Unit-aware writes use a single native mutation per item, registered status roles, explicit scopes and SDK history revision checks. The ordinary-writer read-to-write window remains and is documented; no lock-isolation claim.
